name: reveal.js-hotspot
description: Annotate an image in place: markers on the picture, a tap opens the explanation beside them. Positions are percentages, so nothing is measured at runtime. Built-in multimodal-style full screen keeps the markers working; in ?print-pdf the numbered picture stays on its slide and its full legend prints on a page of its own, so nothing is cut off.
author: Florian Loyns
